plugins.name: assets
plugins.description: Provides configuration authoring, session and read-asset discovery (surgery metadata today) skills for sollertia-shared-assets. Includes MCP bindings for reading, writing, and validating every Sollertia platform shared asset (configuration files, session YAMLs, subject records, task templates, and forged-dataset markers and column descriptions), and serves the Unity Editor relay tools the unity plugin consumes. Owns the library's extension path, the registry system by which a new acquisition system, session type, trial class, trigger type, read asset, or credentials category is added. Backed by the sollertia-shared-assets MCP server (slsa). System-specific record schemas live in the per-system companion plugin (e.g. the mesoscope plugin).

plugins.name: unity
plugins.description: Provides Unity Editor integration skills for the sollertia-virtual-reality project. Generates tasks from YAML task templates, manages VR scenes, drives Play Mode, reads and writes the Task Parameters window, clones trigger zone prefabs, and documents the MQTT contract with sollertia-experiment, the CreateTask generation pipeline, the inlined GIMBL VR framework, Editor-time scene setup, and the Unity Test Framework suite with its assembly definition layout. Uses the fifteen-tool Unity relay served by the assets plugin's slsa MCP server and the McpBridge editor plugin.

plugins.name: experiment
plugins.description: Agentic access to the sollertia-experiment and sollertia-micro-controllers libraries: the system-agnostic core for acquisition system design, hardware interfaces, runtime patterns, external data-service processors, hardware discovery and system health checks, the host-side Unity VR task driver, end-to-end build and operation pipelines, and session lifecycle management on the experiment host. Owns the extension path of both libraries, the configuration registry and shared cross_system primitives a new acquisition system composes, the MCP tool-module and CLI group registration seams, and the firmware module, controller target, and board family seams. System-specific skills live in dedicated companion plugins (e.g. the 'mesoscope' plugin for the Mesoscope-VR reference system). Backed by the single sollertia-experiment MCP server (sle mcp), which registers the hardware-agnostic tool module alongside the active system's own, covering both the `sle get` and `sle mesoscope` surfaces. The MCP tool roster does not mirror the CLI command roster, and the session-acquisition runtimes stay CLI-only. Its hardware-discovery and health-check skills additionally require the assets plugin's sollertia-shared-assets MCP server (slsa mcp) and the ataraxis marketplace's ataraxis-video-system (axvs mcp) and ataraxis-communication-interface (axci mcp) servers.

plugins.name: mesoscope
plugins.description: Provides the Mesoscope-VR reference acquisition system, the worked example an agent copies when implementing a new system through `assets:library-extension`. Covers the sollertia-experiment system-specific layer (hardware subsystem inventory and MesoscopeSystemConfiguration, the runtime state machine, orchestrator, UIs, `sle mesoscope` CLI, and per-session Zaber and Mesoscope position snapshots), the sollertia-shared-assets Mesoscope-VR record schemas (session descriptors, MesoscopeHardwareState, and MesoscopeExperimentConfiguration trial structures), and the sollertia-forgery Mesoscope-VR processing layer (module parsing, trial decomposition, fluorescence alignment, dataset assembly, and the BehaviorDataFiles and DatasetColumn rosters). Optional system plugin layered on the core plugins. Relies on and requires both the experiment plugin's sollertia-experiment MCP server (sle mcp) and the assets plugin's sollertia-shared-assets MCP server (slsa mcp), and on the forging plugin's sollertia-forgery MCP server (slf mcp) for the processing and forging half.

plugins.name: forging
plugins.description: Provides the sollertia-forgery data processing and dataset forging skills: behavior processing with its input artifacts and output feathers, cross-system camera timestamp extraction, the agnostic microcontroller feather-parsing primitives, checksum verification, project manifests, dataset definition and batch dataset forging with their input and output formats, remote server configuration, and the platform-general data-processing design doctrine. Delegates session discovery, filtering, and dataset container reads and writes to the assets plugin, and defers per-system stage schemas to the acquisition system's companion plugin (e.g. the mesoscope plugin). Backed by the sollertia-forgery MCP server (slf).
